focus_areas: Species-specific facial features (absence of cheek pads)
Fur texture realism and edge definition
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the orange fur and the green grass. AI models often create a 'halo' or muddy blend here. Also, scrutinize the folded arm on the right side of the image to ensure the hand anatomy doesn't dissolve into the shoulder fur. Verify that the facial structure lacks the prominent cheek pads of a mature male, consistent with a female or sub-adult classification.
image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of an orangutan lying in tall green grass. The subject is covered in long, shaggy reddish-brown fur. The face is visible, showing a broad structure with dark eyes and small ears. One arm is curled across the chest, while the other is partially obscured by the body and grass. The background consists entirely of textured green vegetation.
